movelist.name: Reflect
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Reflect may activate it when receiving Physical Damage to resist the Damage one step. Reflect may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Uproar
movelist.effect: All Pokémon and Trainers within 5 meters of the user are cured of sleep.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: The user’s Accuracy cannot be lowered, their attacks cannot have Accuracy Penalties (such as from Illuminate), the user is immune to the Blind condition (but not Total Blindness), and the user ignores any Evasion not directly derived from Stats (such as from the Instinct Ability, or from moves like Minimize).

abilities.name: Tinted Lens
abilities.effect: The user’s Resisted Moves are instead Neutral. The user’s Doubly Resisted Moves are instead Resisted. The user’s Triply Resisted Moves are instead Double Resisted.
